title: Colorful Aurora over Icelandic Waterfall
explanation: What a sight to behold, when a night sky became filled with colors that appeared to rain over the Skógafoss waterfall in Iceland.     This image was taken in a single 5 second exposure by the photographer in April 2025.   Seeing an aurora is on many people's bucket lists.   But it is not easy.   It requires high solar activity, dark and clear skies, and usually a viewing location at high latitude.
